title: rubus schleicheri var. spinosellus
intro: Rubus schleicheri var. spinosellus, commonly known as the Himalayan Raspberry, is a plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to the Himalayan region. The Himalayan Raspberry is known for its edible fruits, leaves, and roots, which have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant's health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Rubus schleicheri var. spinosellus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
